lines.text: Endmin! I have some great news!
I've officially been appointed the project lead for the Purification Node! I'm going to keep researching water treatment systems from now on!
Yes! They mentioned a highly feasible efficiency enhancement plan for water treatment in their thesis! It's a bit outdated now ... but it's really inspiring!
A device modified according to this plan wouldn't just process polluted water, it could even extract some valuable materials from it!
The whole thing is still in its experimental phase, though... I'll probably need a couple more rounds of adjustments before the modifications are fully complete.
I've already implemented some new modifications to the device. Endmin, you're welcome to come and test it out anytime!

options: Is this more research left behind by your seniors?

lines.text: Interested in trying the latest iteration of the Purification Node, Endmin?

options: Yeah. I'd like to give it a try.

lines.text: Endmin, I've added a feature upgrade to the improved Purification Node. It can now process even more sewage!
Heheh. Interested in trying it out?
Of course. No rush! I'll be here for a while. Come talk to me if you need anything!

options: Great. Thank you for your hard work.
Yeah. Time for some feasibility trials.

lines.text: Endmin, after many hours of hard work, I've finally upgraded the Purification Node to the highest performance possible!
Goes without saying! If you want, I can even show you the latest version right now.
Sure. Talk to me any time once you're ready for a trial run!

options: Sounds incredible! So, can I test it out?
Thanks a lot. I always wanted to be the first to try.

lines.text: Endmin, my research has finally reached its conclusion. Feel free to check on the Purification Node any time!
